chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah and 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:

Abu 'Abdullah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (عليه السلام) passed away when he was sixty-five years old, in the year one hundred and forty-eight, and he lived for thirty-four years after Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام).

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: the kunyah of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (عليه السلام)
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: When did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This report records the passing of Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (عليه السلام), stating his age at death and the year in which he passed away. It also notes the length of his life after Imam Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام), preserving a biographical detail important to the historical record of the Imams.

en.hubeali: Sa’d Bin Abdullah, and Abdullah Bin Ja’far, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘Abu Abdullah Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was fifty-six years old in the year one hundred and forty eight (A.H.), and he<sup>asws</sup> lived after Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> for thirty-four years’.
en.sarwar: 7. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far all have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali Mahziyar from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from abu Basir who has said the following. “
Abu ‘Abdallah, Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) passed away at the age of fifty bsix in the year one hundred forty eight AH. He lived after abu Ja‘far (a.s.), his father for forty three years.”
